audit.scope: Same-machine fixed sample only. All reports and retained audio audited; removed scratch WAVs were verified during construction, not available for later full waveform readback.

interpretation_limits: All library baselines remain unknown-history, before and after non-codec processing.
Purely synthetic baselines have controlled no-codec histories but only four shared recipes, not independent commercial productions.
Each controlled intervention is applied equally to the baseline and the corresponding codec-derived example.
Non-codec processing can degrade fidelity without introducing a lossy codec stage. Such degradation is not a positive history label.
Null remains missing; interaction statistics require all four feature values.
Quantizer saturation is counted and retained, not normalized away or used for source exclusion.
These descriptive measurements do not estimate false-positive rates, detection rates, calibrated probabilities or real-music accuracy.
No fitted model, threshold, release gate change, public verdict or release promotion.

scratch_retention.recovery: Scratch WAVs are reproducible from bound source files, toolchain, code and seeds; hashes and measurements are retained.
